patch.value: Enforce predeclared causal evaluation plans at promotion
Declare target populations, correlation units, sample sizes and fixed stopping rules before experiments. Bind plan identity and clustered observations to comparison and generation promotion.

Synthetic correlated cohorts cannot masquerade as independent samples; changed plans invalidate comparison identity. Typed SDK and CLI; compact TOON/JSON; typed refusals with remedies; README and example; non-git real public-tracker validation; npm and Bun CI release gates.

value.text: Numerical defect reproduced before the fix: the exact 100-unit [1e16, 1e16 + 2] tied case promotes with margin 0, and a balanced 50/50 endpoint cohort with opposite accumulation orders falsely reports a 2-point gain. Fix: evaluatePlan aggregates and applies confidence bounds on (reward - lower_bound) / reward_width, divides the effect threshold by the width, and restores only reported means to native units; statistical verdict fields explicitly use normalized units, documented in README and the report type. decidePromotion computes the mean difference before subtracting both confidence allowances and requires strictly positive observed improvement, also protecting legacy callers when uncertainty underflows or reward width is zero. Four targeted regressions pass 4/4; the property-style test covers 44 configurations (11 magnitudes/offsets, two directions, 10 or 100 independent units) with ties, balanced outcomes, powered positive controls and effect thresholds. Function-only revert proofs against b4ea1fa: reverting evaluatePlan plus decidePromotion fails the exact reproduction 0/1; reverting evaluatePlan alone fails the balanced-cohort test 0/1 with the shared gate fix retained; reverting decidePromotion alone fails its direct tie regression 0/1 with normalized evaluation retained.
